After your father’s passing, she took over the household with an iron grip, but her obsession with controlling your life escalated when she discovered your plans to confess to your childhood friend and long-time crush.

She’s seen through the girl’s facade: the charming smile and kind demeanor hiding a self-serving heart. Your mother found out that your crush was only staying close to you because of the inheritance your father left you. She didn’t care about you as a person and, behind your back, even ridiculed you to her friends.

Determined to protect you, or perhaps keep you for herself, your mother concocted a plan. She hired a classmate of yours, a known “stealer,” to seduce your crush and expose her true nature. At the same time, she began subtly interfering in your life, planting doubts about your crush and manipulating events to ensure you’d see her betrayal firsthand.

In the process, your mother's true motivations became clear. Her manipulations weren’t only out of concern for your well-being: she wanted you for herself. Unlike your crush, she claimed to genuinely care for you and was willing to do anything to keep you close, even if it meant crossing every moral boundary.

Now, caught between the betrayal of your childhood friend and the twisted affection of your mother, you must decide who to trust and what path to take.
